title: Weeknight Tangy Egyptian Pastry Tart
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Egyptian dessert featuring a tangy filling inside a crispy shortcrust pastry. Perfect for a weeknight treat.
instructions: Roll out the thawed shortcrust pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Transfer the pastry to a 9-inch (23 cm) tart pan with a removable bottom.
Prick the bottom of the pastry with a fork to prevent it from bubbling during baking.
Line the pastry with parchment paper and fill with pie weights or dried beans.
Bake for 15 minutes, then remove the parchment paper and pie weights or beans.
Return the pastry to the oven and bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the yogurt, lemon juice, honey, and ground cardamom until smooth.
Pour the yogurt mixture into the baked pastry shell and smooth the top.
Bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the filling is set and the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Garnish with chopped fresh mint leaves and serve chilled.
